::: {#hero-heading}

Hello and welcome! I am an ecologist, R developper, and consultant with a love for complex problem solving. Currently, I'm a PhD candidate in the [Ecosystem Ecology Lab](https://shawnleroux.wixsite.com/lerouxlab) at Memorial University in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. There, I spend my days clarifying the role of dead organic matter in providing sustaining nutrition to ecosystems across time and space. Outside my PhD research I have developed novel methods to estimate the impact of barriers on fish movement. I am also passionate about R programming and open science for which I have led multiple trainings and workshops. You can read more about these activites in [Research](research).

<br>

:::
